t1.RELEASE_NO: key: newest edition (the higher release number on a shared date)
t1.RELEASE_DATE: key: newest edition — selects its rows

t1.ROW: key: row order; labels are found by text, not by row number

t1.C27: chart-years, chart-mix, chart-ytd — insurance and government, original
t1.C28: chart-years, chart-ytd, insight:startups — start-ups and exceptional intangible deals, original
